## What Problem Is Being Solved?

Machine learning is best learned by doing. This repository provides structured, executable notebooks that support my teaching and help students and practitioners build ML skills step by step.

## How It Works

A collection of **Jupyter notebooks** in Python covering machine-learning fundamentals, from data preparation through supervised and unsupervised learning.

## My Role

Author and maintainer, using the notebooks in courses such as [Machine Learning](../../teaching/machine-learning/index.qmd) and [Data Mining](../../teaching/data-mining/index.qmd).

## What Was Produced

A reusable, open teaching resource for machine learning.
